evals.prompt: Design a 1-story 3-bedroom courtyard house on a 20m x 16m site with North at the top. Produce the complete architectural spatial design, structural grid, room schedule with Neufert clearances, and coordinate all 2D orthographic planes (Floor Plan at +1.20m cut, Reflected Ceiling Plan, Longitudinal & Transverse Sections, and N/S/E/W Elevations).
evals.expected_output: A complete architectural design grounded in Ching, Neufert, and Alexander patterns with an explicit A-D / 1-4 structural grid, consolidated wet core, <=18% circulation ratio, 3-tier exterior dimensions with 45-degree architectural ticks, and coordinated multi-plane specifications.
expectations: Establishes a clear Parti, intimacy gradient (Arrival -> Social Pavilion -> Private Sanctuary), and consolidated shared wet walls.
Defines an alphanumeric structural column grid (A, B, C... and 1, 2, 3...) with rational bay spans.
Sizes all rooms, doors, corridors, and stairs according to Neufert anthropometrics and Blondel's stair formula (600mm <= 2R + T <= 630mm).
Specifies all coordinated 2D orthographic planes: Floor Plan (+1.20m cut), Reflected Ceiling Plan (unflipped mirror projection), Roof Plan, Sections (A-A, B-B), and 4 Exterior Elevations.
Uses AIA standard AutoCAD layers (A-GRID, A-WALL-FULL, A-DOOR, A-GLAZ, A-OVER, A-ANNO-DIMS) and lineweight hierarchy (0.50mm cut walls down to 0.09mm grid/hatch).

evals.prompt: Review this residential floor plan proposal: Master bedroom is 2.8m x 3.1m with a 0.65m door and one small 0.6m x 0.6m window; the hallway is 0.75m wide and consumes 26% of the house area; the stair has 195mm risers and 230mm treads; the bathroom and kitchen are on opposite corners of the house. Critique this like a senior architect and provide corrected metric specifications.
evals.expected_output: A rigorous architectural critique identifying every anthropometric, code, and spatial efficiency failure, paired with exact corrected dimensions from Neufert and IBC/NBC codes.
expectations: Flags the 2.8m x 3.1m (8.68m²) master bedroom as below Neufert minimum width (3.20m) and area (12.0m²).
Flags the 0.65m bedroom door and 0.75m hallway as code/ergonomic failures (requires >=0.80m bedroom door and >=0.90m–1.20m corridor).
Calculates the window glazing ratio (0.36m² / 8.68m² = 4.1%) and flags it as violating the >=10% habitable room daylight requirement.
Applies Blondel's Law (2*195 + 230 = 620mm, but R=195mm exceeds max 170–175mm residential riser and T=230mm is below min 280mm tread) and corrects to R=155–165mm, T=290–300mm.
Critiques the 26% corridor circulation waste (target <=15–18%) and consolidates the scattered kitchen/bathroom along a shared 150–200mm wet wall.

evals.prompt: Generate a validated AutoCAD 2D floor plan (.dxf and .scr) for a courtyard residence using the professional-architect-2d-cad skill scripts and verify that all anthropometric checks pass.
evals.expected_output: Runs validate_floor_plan.py with 0 errors and runs generate_dxf_plan.py to output a multi-layer AutoCAD .dxf and .scr file with AIA layers and 45-degree architectural dimensions.
expectations: Executes validate_floor_plan.py against the building specification JSON and confirms 0 anthropometric/code errors.
Executes generate_dxf_plan.py to produce floor_plan_a101.dxf and floor_plan_a101.scr.
Populates AIA layers including A-GRID, A-COLS, A-WALL-FULL, A-DOOR, A-DOOR-SWNG, A-GLAZ, A-OVER, A-ANNO-DIMS, A-ANNO-TEXT, and A-TTLB.
